top_signals.title: House Republicans Move to Block Trump's Russian Diesel Deal
top_signals.summary: Republican Representative Brian Fitzpatrick plans to force a House vote on legislation blocking Russian oil purchases, challenging President Donald Trump's decision to ease restrictions on Russian diesel exports as lawmakers warn the move could help finance Moscow's war against Ukraine. top_signals.title: Inside AvisLoader: A Windows Malware Loader Built to Resist Disruption
top_signals.summary: A new Windows malware loader called AvisLoader uses encrypted peer-to-peer communications to make command-and-control infrastructure harder to disrupt. Varonis researchers explain how the malware uses ClickFix delivery, shortcut-based persistence, and remote command execution capabilities. [...]

top_signals.title: Mixed outlook for energy expenditures this winter
top_signals.summary: We expect energy expenditures this winter to vary because of diverging trends in energy prices among fuels and regional variation in forecast temperatures. We expect that lower prices for natural gas and propane will drive decreases in expenditures this year for the half of U.S. households heating with those fuels. Higher prices for electricity and heating oil drive increased expenditures for households heating with those fuels in our forecast.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
